title: Lumen community modules catalog
description: Schema validating modules.json, the Lumen store catalog. See docs/architecture/store-architecture.md in the Lumen app repo.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this catalog schema. Bumped whenever the entry shape changes in a breaking way; the app rejects catalogs it doesn't understand.

id.description: Reverse-DNS id, must equal the module's own manifest.json id. Globally unique.

name.description: Display name shown in the store.

tagline.description: Short one-line description shown in the catalog rows.

description.description: Longer markdown description shown on the detail page.

tags.description: Taxonomy tags used for filtering (e.g. utility, engagement).

author.description: Module author. url is their GitHub profile; the avatar is derived from it.

license.description: SPDX identifier of the module license.

repo.description: The author's GitHub repo the app fetches releases from (owner/repo).

icon.description: Optional path to an icon asset in this repo (icons/<id>/icon.svg).

cover.description: Optional path to a cover asset in this repo (covers/<id>/cover.png).

lumenVerified.description: Optional first-party badge granted by the Lumen team during review. Trust signal only; grants no extra permissions.

status.description: Moderation state. v1 only writes approved; the rest are reserved for later.

approvedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the entry was approved.
